short: The fractional ideal for the modified lattice

lean.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.DV.Iu
lean.plain: The fractional ideal for the modified lattice
lean.note: The fractional ideal rescales the ramified lattice one prime at a time. At $\lambda$ the exponent is $-\lfloor e_\lambda g(u,\lambda)\rfloor$, the negative of the valuation threshold for periods.
